dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Maybe a month or less. After 2-3 months we already planned us flying out of the country to meet her family and 4 months later we moved in together. Its been 6 years now and we get along so well it almost feels wrong.
@dogecoin_empire We usually don't talk about anything important. We don't talk about things that are stressors in life. You get enough of that every day. It's things that are funny or entertaining.
